[element-issue-title]
=== `<issue-title>` Issue Title (in a citation)

Within a citation (such as a <<element-mixed-citation,`<mixed-citation>`>> or an <<element-element-citation,`<element-citation>`>>), names the theme or special title for a journal issue.
